author: Nickolas Patrick Joseph Schoff

core_principle.statement: Each English letter maps uniquely to an integer 1–26, represented as a polygon with that number of sides.

decoding_algorithm: 1. For each symbol at index i (starting at 1):
ii. If permutation enabled: compute original n using reverse_transform.
iii. Map n to corresponding letter.
iv. Apply case using orientation flag.
b. If punctuation symbol: map back to punctuation mark.
description: Lossless, reversible symbolic encoding system mapping English characters to polygon side counts.
encoding_algorithm: 2. For each character at index i (starting at 1):
i. Convert to uppercase for numeric lookup.
ii. Map letter to numeric value n (1–26).
iii. If permutation enabled: compute n' using forward_transform.
b. If punctuation: emit mapped punctuation symbol.
3. Output ordered list of symbol objects.

optional_permutation_layer.forward_transform: n' = (n + f(i,S)) mod 26; if result == 0, set to 26
optional_permutation_layer.reverse_transform: n = (n' - f(i,S)) mod 26; if result == 0, set to 26

security_note: This system provides structural obfuscation, not modern cryptographic security.

symbol_representation.note: Visual rendering optional. Numeric side count is authoritative.

usage_instructions: 1. Both AI agents must ingest this JSON file fully.
2. Both agents must agree on shared_seed_S if permutation is enabled.
3. Only transmit encoded symbol structures between agents.
4. Do not transmit plaintext alongside encoded data.
